# robotDictionaryTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [robotDictionaryTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/robotDictionaryTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  A Robot of exudyn.robotics saved and loaded (#3267): Robot.GetDictionary gives the parameters, the links,
#           base and tool with their graphics data as a dict, Robot.SetDictionary builds the robot from it; the dict is
#           saved to an HDF5 file with exudyn.advancedUtilities.SaveDictToHDF5 and loaded with LoadDictFromHDF5 (if
#           h5py is installed). The Staubli TX2-90L of exudyn.robotics.models with graphics, q0, friction and PD
#           control: the loaded robot has the same dict, the same tool frame and the same motion in a kinematic tree.
#           The result is 1 if all checks pass plus the joint coordinates at the end, weighted by 1 to 6.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-05
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
from exudyn.basicUtilities import OutputFilePath
from exudyn.robotics import Robot
from exudyn.robotics.models import ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L, LinkDict2Robot
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

def Equal(a, b):
    """True if the two dicts of GetDictionary agree in keys, types and values"""
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        return isinstance(b, dict) and set(a.keys()) == set(b.keys()) and all(Equal(a[key], b[key]) for key in a)
    if isinstance(a, list):
        return isinstance(b, list) and len(a) == len(b) and all(Equal(x, y) for (x, y) in zip(a, b))
    if a is None or isinstance(a, (str, bool)):
        return type(a) is type(b) and a == b
    return np.array_equal(np.array(a), np.array(b))

def SimulateTree(robot):
    """the joint coordinates of the kinematic tree of robot after 0.2 s under gravity, held by the PD control at q0"""
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    robot.CreateKinematicTree(mbs)
    mbs.Assemble()
    simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 100
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.2
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    return mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(robot.modelData['objectKinematicTree'], exu.OutputVariableType.Coordinates)

checks = []
robot = LinkDict2Robot(ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L())
robot.q0 = [0.1, 0.4, 1.2, -0.3, 0.8, 0.2]
robot.SetJointFriction(viscous=0.5, coulomb=1.)
robot.base.visualization.graphicsData = [graphics.Cylinder([0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0.3], radius=0.2, color=graphics.color.grey)]
robot.tool.visualization.graphicsData = [graphics.Brick([0, 0, 0.02], [0.05, 0.05, 0.04], color=graphics.color.red)]
for link in robot.links:
    link.visualization.graphicsData = [graphics.Brick(link.COM, [0.1, 0.1, 0.2], color=graphics.color.lightgrey, addEdges=True)]

robotDict = robot.GetDictionary()
robot2 = Robot()
robot2.SetDictionary(robotDict)
checks += [Equal(robotDict, robot2.GetDictionary())]

try:
    import h5py, scipy #both needed by SaveDictToHDF5
    hasH5py = True
except ImportError:
    hasH5py = False
    exu.Print('h5py or scipy not available; the HDF5 file is not tested')
if hasH5py:
    from exudyn.advancedUtilities import SaveDictToHDF5, LoadDictFromHDF5
    fileName = OutputFilePath('solution/robotTX2.h5', 'robotDictionaryTest')
    SaveDictToHDF5(fileName, robotDict)
    robot2 = Robot()
    robot2.SetDictionary(LoadDictFromHDF5(fileName))
    checks += [Equal(robotDict, robot2.GetDictionary())]

HT = robot.GetKinematicChain().ToolHT(robot.q0).HT44()
HT2 = robot2.GetKinematicChain().ToolHT(robot2.q0).HT44()
checks += [np.max(np.abs(HT - HT2)) == 0]

q = SimulateTree(robot)
q2 = SimulateTree(robot2)
checks += [np.max(np.abs(q - q2)) == 0 and np.max(np.abs(q - robot.q0)) < 1e-2]

#a dict of another kind is refused
try:
    robot2.SetDictionary({'links': []})
    checks += [False]
except ValueError:
    checks += [True]

u = float(all(checks)) + q @ np.arange(1, 7) #the same with and without h5py
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of robotDictionaryTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
